items.title: Climate Risk Assessment for UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Southeast Asia: 2025-2050 Projections
items.authors: Tanawat Chaisuwan, Nguyen Thi Mai, Siti Nurhaliza, David Smith
items.abstract: This study assesses climate change risks for 44 UNESCO World Heritage sites across Southeast Asia using CMIP6 climate projections under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 scenarios. Key findings include: 62% of coastal heritage sites face high flood risk by 2050, traditional masonry structures show increased weathering rates due to temperature-humidity coupling, and 15 sites may require emergency adaptation measures within the next decade.
